LanguageData.StatCompression_ShowInfoCardSettingsButt: Show the "Compression settings" button on info cards
LanguageData.StatCompression_SP_BodyPartHealth_Baseli: This affects the HP of every body part. Baseline represents a pawn's unmodified base body-part HP for its race. For convenience, this value is normalized to 1 (100%); 2 means double HP.
LanguageData.StatCompression_SP_Damage_BaselineToolti: For base-damage modules, Baseline is the base damage of equipment, pawns, or items. For example, if a punch deals 9 damage, its baseline is 9.
LanguageData.StatCompression_SP_Damage_DirectionToolt: Base damage only supports compressing values above the threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_SP_HediffStageFactor_Bas: This is a Hediff (health condition) field. Baseline 1 represents 100% of the base value; 2 means double the value.
LanguageData.StatCompression_SP_RegenerationRate_Base: The regeneration Baseline is measured in HP per day. A typical pawn has 0 HP/day, while a ghoul may have 100 HP/day or more.
LanguageData.StatCompression_SP_HediffStage_Direction: The direction is fixed by the field's game semantics: high healing/regeneration values are compressed, while low bleed, hunger, rest-fall, and food-poisoning factors are compressed.
LanguageData.StatCompression_MethodTooltip: Different ways to reduce high values. Compression becomes stronger from left to right.
LanguageData.StatCompression_MethodDescription_Linear: Keep a fixed proportion of the amount beyond the threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_MethodDescription_Power: Values are compressed substantially throughout the range.
LanguageData.StatCompression_MethodDescription_Logari: Low values change little, while very high values are compressed significantly.
LanguageData.StatCompression_MethodDescription_SoftCa: Values approach a configured upper limit without reaching it.
LanguageData.StatCompression_Formula_Logarithmic: Logarithmic: f(x) = h + ln(1 + ln(t)(x - h)) / ln(t)
LanguageData.StatCompression_Formula_SoftCap: Soft cap: f(x) = h + t(x - h) / ((x - h) + t)
LanguageData.StatCompression_ParameterDirection_Small: Smaller means stronger compression; 1 means no compression.
LanguageData.StatCompression_ParameterDirection_Large: Larger means stronger compression; values near 1 are weak.
LanguageData.StatCompression_ParameterAmplifiesWarnin: The current t is above 1 and amplifies the excess instead of compressing it.
LanguageData.StatCompression_ParameterTooltip: Adjust this value to change compression strength. The slider provides a convenient range; values outside it can be entered manually.
LanguageData.StatCompression_CompressAboveTooltip: 100% starts compression at each stat's own Baseline; 150% starts after the stat exceeds 1.5 times its Baseline. Only the amount beyond the trigger is reduced. Lower-ratio stats are checked in reciprocal space; their actual trigger is shown in Advanced settings.
LanguageData.StatCompression_PresetSectionHint: Advanced settings can edit and create presets. You can also import or export presets through the clipboard, or adjust compression strength in Global simple settings.
LanguageData.StatCompression_Preset_ErrorInvalidName: The preset name cannot be used as a file name.
LanguageData.StatCompression_Preset_ErrorNoSelection: Select at least one config row.
LanguageData.StatCompression_RestoreDefaultPresets: Delete all presets and use defaults only
LanguageData.StatCompression_RestoreDefaultPresetsCon:
Delete every local preset and restore the bundled defaults?
Current preset files will be permanently deleted. All default presets will be recreated and enabled, and compression configs outside those defaults will be disabled.
LanguageData.StatCompression_RestoreDefaultPresetsCom: Deleted {0} preset file(s), recreated and applied {1} default preset(s), and skipped {2} missing stat(s).
LanguageData.StatCompression_PresetClipboardInvalid: The clipboard does not contain a valid Stat Compression preset: {0}
LanguageData.StatCompression_PresetOverwriteConfirm: The user preset "{0}" already exists. Overwrite it?
LanguageData.StatCompression_PresetBuiltinConflict: The built-in preset "{0}" cannot be overwritten. Rename the preset in the XML and import it again.
LanguageData.StatCompression_ResetConfirmText:
Reset all Stat Compression settings?
This restores global settings, every stat configuration, and all special-module configurations, and disables active presets. User preset files will not be deleted.
LanguageData.StatCompression_ResetCompleted: Stat Compression settings have been reset.
LanguageData.StatCompression_ImportedMessage: Imported settings XML: updated={0}, skipped={1}, path={2}
LanguageData.StatCompression_AdvancedSimpleHelp: Configure how each stat is compressed. Each stat is normalized using its baseline and Direction, then checked against its threshold percentage. There are four compression methods. Follow global uses the method and parameter from Global simple settings. The t value controls compression efficiency.
LanguageData.StatCompression_DisplayT_Tooltip: t Scale is editable and larger values always strengthen compression. Actual t is the read-only parameter used by the calculation.
LanguageData.StatCompression_ResizeColumnTooltip: Drag to resize this column. Click the header to sort.
LanguageData.StatCompression_SelectStatForPreview: Select a stat row to preview its compression mapping.
LanguageData.StatCompression_AdvancedDetail_Direction: Normalization: Higher direct; only the amount above T is processed. x ≤ T: result = x x > T: e=(x-T)÷B G(x,F)=T+B×F(e)
Normalization: Lower ratio; for multipliers that become stronger near zero. x < 0 or x ≥ T: result = x 0 ≤ x < T: e=B÷max(x,1e-10)-threshold G(x,F)=B÷(threshold+F(e))
Normalization: Lower direct; processes additive differences below T. x ≥ T: result = x x < T: e=(T-x)÷B G(x,F)=T-B×F(e)
LanguageData.StatCompression_AdvancedDetail_Flow: Calculation: original x → check whether x crosses T → normalize excess e → reduce it with F(e) → restore stat units with G(x,F) → compressed value
LanguageData.StatCompression_DirectionExplanation_Hig: Directly compress the portion above the threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_DirectionExplanation_Low: Take the reciprocal, directly compress the portion above the threshold, then take the reciprocal again.
Directly compress the portion below the threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_DirectionTooltip: Higher direct: directly compress the portion above the threshold. Lower ratio: take the reciprocal, directly compress the portion above the threshold, then take the reciprocal again. Lower direct: directly compress the portion below the threshold.
LanguageData.StatCompression_TScaleTooltip: Adjust this value to change compression strength.
LanguageData.StatCompression_Explanation_Hint_Power: Power compression: multiplicative gains are proportionally reduced
LanguageData.StatCompression_Explanation_Hint_Power_L: Power compression: multiplicative gains are proportionally reduced
LanguageData.StatCompression_Explanation_Hint_Logarit: Logarithmic compression: multiplicative gains become additive
Logarithmic compression: multiplicative gains become additive
LanguageData.StatCompression_Explanation_Hint_SoftCap: Soft cap compression: values never exceed a fixed upper limit.
Soft cap compression: values never fall below a fixed lower limit.
LanguageData.StatCompression_BaseDamage_Info_AfterFac: Only the base damage is shown here. Equipment, pawn, material, and other factors are applied afterward.
